CapStablecoin.$comment: Cap protocol's held synthetic dollar (cUSD), valued in USDC via cUSD's burn quote. Sibling of CapSavings: the former combined `Cap` adapter served BOTH legs from one contract and branched its label literals on positionId, which a per-adapter AssetKindRegistry label override cannot express (one write rewrote both legs at both indices). One adapter per leg makes every label segment a per-adapter constant. Labels: ["Stablecoin", "cUSD"], kind Supplied, positionId = abi.encode(cUSD).

CapSavings.$comment: Cap protocol's staked savings token (stcUSD), valued in USDC via ERC4626 convertToAssets then cUSD's burn quote. Sibling of CapStablecoin (see its comment for why Cap is two adapters). `cUsd` is required here as the burn-quote oracle for the second hop, not as the other leg's token. Labels: ["Savings", "stcUSD"], kind Staking, positionId = abi.encode(stcUSD).

EtherFiWithdrawalQueueAssisted.$comment: ether.fi withdrawal-queue assisted adapter (ADR 0015/0018/0030). Caches WithdrawRequestNFT tokenIds only, never amounts; values each live (finalized: getClaimableAmount, else min(amountOfEEth, amountForShare) - fee) and re-verifies ownerOf on every read. Fed by the owner Safe through EtherFiWithdrawalQueueAssistant (msg.sender-keyed submit/remove) and, for requests not opened through the assistant, by a SUBMITTER_ROLE keeper (submitFor). 04 passes the chain's securityCouncil as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; no submitter is granted at deploy. 04 reads withdrawRequestNft, liquidityPool, underlyingToken; eeth is for the assistant.

NexusMutualStakingPoolsAssisted.$comment: Nexus Mutual staking pools assisted adapter (ADR 0015/0018/0030). Caches StakingNFT tokenIds only, never amounts; values each via StakingViewer.getTokens into NXM Staking (active+expired) + Rewards legs, re-verifying tokenInfo ownership on every read. Fed by the owner Safe through NexusMutualStakingPoolsAssistant (msg.sender-keyed submit/remove) and, for positions not opened through the assistant, by a SUBMITTER_ROLE keeper (submitFor). 04 passes the chain's securityCouncil as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; no submitter is granted at deploy. tokenController is for the assistant.

StakeWiseV3ExitQueueAssisted.$comment: StakeWise V3 exit-queue assisted adapter (ADR 0015/0018/0030). Caches (vault, positionTicket, timestamp) tuples only, never amounts; vaults gated by the VaultsRegistry; values each live via calculateExitedAssets (claimable after exitClaimDelay, else locked). Fed by the owner Safe through StakeWiseV3ExitQueueAssistant (msg.sender-keyed submit/remove) and, for positions not opened through the assistant (the StakeWise Assistant registers a partial claim's remainder itself; the keeper is the backstop), by a SUBMITTER_ROLE keeper (submitFor). 04 passes the chain's securityCouncil as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; no submitter is granted at deploy.
